reconstruction.scope: Visitors Centre, Yad Vashem: mapped square pale-concrete frame with six reconstructed bays per side, deep open perimeter colonnades, tall recessed mullioned glass, a car-park entrance below a notch in the upper fascia, low-frequency roof-panel grid and selected end-bay louvres. All four LODs keep the frame, recesses and roof notch. Interior visitor facilities, signs/photographic posters, benches, visitors, cars, trees and independent campus buildings remain context.
